headline: Envision Delivers Low-Carbon Ammonia Environmental Attribute Certificates to PepsiCo APAC, Pioneering Decarbonization in the Fertilizer Industry
summary: On July 30th 2026, Envision Energy, a global leader in green technology, announced a low carbon ammonia environmental attribute purchase agreement with PepsiCo APAC and completed delivery of the first 1,000 tonnes of low carbon ammonia environmental attribute certificates (EACs). The EACs are being issued and managed through S3 Markets' environmental attribute registry.
